# Codex Rate Monitor v0.3.2

## 中文

### 修复

- 修复桌面悬浮条遮挡全屏内容的问题：仅在悬浮条所在屏幕全屏时自动隐藏，退出后原位恢复；普通最大化不受影响，后台额度监控继续运行。（[#10](https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/issues/10)）

### 改进

- 加快外观设置窗口打开速度，减少等待。

## English

### Fixes

- Fixed the desktop overlay covering fullscreen content. It now hides automatically only when an application is fullscreen on the overlay's monitor, then returns to its original position afterward. Normal maximized windows are unaffected, and quota monitoring continues in the background. ([#10](https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/issues/10))

### Improvements

- Appearance settings open faster, with less waiting.

[Full changelog / 完整变更](https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2)
